lessons.text: Never use appeal to popularity (Everyone believes it, therefore it is true). It cost you against John Maynard Keynes.
Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against John Maynard Keynes.
Never use appeal to emotion (Substituting feeling for reasoning). It cost you against John Maynard Keynes.
